front.title: Metric Snapshot Exchange between SCI and C-SMA in CATS

abstract.t: This document specifies metric snapshot exchange between a Service Contact Instance (SCI) and a CATS Service Metric Agent (C-SMA). It defines atomic replacement, ordering, and validity for periodic full snapshots and change-triggered updates over HTTPS/JSON. An informative appendix explains how one shared snapshot YANG model can support generation of the publication and response messages.
